why: From A to B the inside and outside shapes change places: the small diamond becomes the big outer shape and the triangle goes inside. Doing the same with C, the house-shaped pentagon becomes the big outer shape (turned on its side) and the diamond goes inside. That is option 3. Options 2 and 4 have a badly bent outer shape, and option 5 has a triangle inside, which was never in C.
trick: In inside-outside questions, first check which shape goes out and which goes in, then check the turning.
note: Book answer option 3. Doubt: in A to B the diamond turned into an upright square, so by the same rule option 1 (pentagon with a square inside) could also be argued. We follow the book.
